data.remark: Computes Fibonacci using fast doubling, without hardcoded tables. Playground result: 5.62M kernel instructions. Includes a universal Lean correctness proof and stays within the 1 MiB submission limit.
data.artifactContent:
import Spec

namespace Submission

structure FibPair where
  current : Nat
  next : Nat

theorem natAdd_eq (a b : Nat) : Nat.add a b = a + b := rfl
theorem natSub_eq (a b : Nat) : Nat.sub a b = a - b := rfl
theorem natMul_eq (a b : Nat) : Nat.mul a b = a * b := rfl
theorem natDiv_eq (a b : Nat) : Nat.div a b = a / b := rfl
theorem natMod_eq (a b : Nat) : Nat.mod a b = a % b := rfl

def double (recur : Nat → FibPair) (n : Nat) : FibPair :=
  bif n.beq 0 then ⟨0, 1⟩ else
    match recur (Nat.div n 2) with
    | ⟨a, b⟩ =>
      let even := Nat.mul a (Nat.sub (Nat.mul 2 b) a)
      let odd := Nat.add (Nat.mul b b) (Nat.mul a a)
      bif (Nat.mod n 2).beq 0 then ⟨even, odd⟩ else ⟨odd, Nat.add even odd⟩

def fibPair (fuel : Nat) : Nat → FibPair :=
  Nat.rec (fun _ => ⟨0, 1⟩) (fun _ recur => double recur) fuel

theorem fibPair_correct (fuel n : Nat) (h : n < 2 ^ fuel) :
    fibPair fuel n = ⟨Nat.fib n, Nat.fib (n + 1)⟩ := by
  induction fuel generalizing n with
  | zero =>
    have hn : n = 0 := by simpa using h
    subst n
    rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    change double (fibPair fuel) n = _
    unfold double
    simp only [Bool.cond_eq_ite, Nat.beq_eq, natAdd_eq, natSub_eq, natMul_eq, natDiv_eq, natMod_eq]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg hn]
      have hk : n / 2 < 2 ^ fuel := by
        rw [pow_succ] at h
        omega
      rw [ih (n / 2) hk]
      dsimp only
      rw [← Nat.fib_two_mul]
      have odd_identity (k : Nat) :
          Nat.fib (k + 1) * Nat.fib (k + 1) + Nat.fib k * Nat.fib k = Nat.fib (2 * k + 1) := by
        simpa only [pow_two] using (Nat.fib_two_mul_add_one k).symm
      rw [odd_identity]
      split_ifs with hp
      · congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega
      · rw [← Nat.fib_add_two]
        congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega

def impl (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  match fibPair n (Nat.div n 2) with
  | ⟨a, b⟩ =>
    bif (Nat.mod n 2).beq 0 then Nat.mul a (Nat.sub (Nat.mul 2 b) a)
    else Nat.add (Nat.mul b b) (Nat.mul a a)

theorem impl_correct : ∀ n, impl n = Nat.fib n := by
  intro n
  unfold impl
  simp only [Bool.cond_eq_ite, Nat.beq_eq, natAdd_eq, natSub_eq, natMul_eq, natDiv_eq, natMod_eq]
  have hk : n / 2 < 2 ^ n := by
    have hn : n < 2 ^ n := Nat.lt_pow_self (by decide)
    omega
  rw [fibPair_correct n (n / 2) hk]
  dsimp only
  split_ifs with hp
  · change Nat.fib (n / 2) * (2 * Nat.fib (n / 2 + 1) - Nat.fib (n / 2)) = _
    rw [← Nat.fib_two_mul]
    congr 1
    omega
  · change Nat.fib (n / 2 + 1) * Nat.fib (n / 2 + 1) + Nat.fib (n / 2) * Nat.fib (n / 2) = _
    rw [← pow_two, ← pow_two, ← Nat.fib_two_mul_add_one]
    congr 1
    omega

end Submission
